characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still in 16:9 widescreen — one frame only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders, no captions. REAL PHOTOGRAPH ONLY: a frame from a live-action Japanese drama shot on a cinema camera — real human skin with pores and fine lines, real fabric weave, real wood grain; NOT an illustration, NOT anime, NOT a painting, NOT CGI. EXPRESSION FIRST — the face must read clearly at a glance on a phone screen, at about 75 percent intensity, overriding the neutral expression of any reference image: Expression — DAWNING PANIC: eyes wide with the whites showing above the iris, brows raised and pulled together, the lower lids tensed, lips parted and the lower lip drawn slightly back, skin gone pale, a visible tightness in the neck; fear arriving in real time. ACTING REALISM: this is a real actor caught mid-thought, not a posed portrait — a subtle NATURAL ASYMMETRY between the two sides of the face, the emotion held mainly in the EYES and the tiny muscles around them (lower eyelids, inner brows, nostrils, the corners of the mouth), the skin reacting (faint flush or pallor where the emotion demands), a believable breath in the chest; NO exaggerated theatrical grimace, NO stock smile with teeth, NO blank mannequin stare, NO perfectly symmetrical frozen face. Photorealistic live-action Japanese drama, authentic contemporary Japanese hot-spring inn (温泉旅館) mise-en-scene, Reiwa era, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, quiet elegant realism, no flat lighting. LOCATION FIRST: the scene takes place in the location of reference image 2; the room, furniture and background of reference image 1 must NOT appear — only its face is used. [CAMERA] MOBILE-FIRST COMPOSITION: this will be watched on a 6-inch phone screen — the key subject (face, hand or object) is LARGE and centred in the middle 60 percent of the frame, high local contrast between subject and background, nothing important near the frame edges or in tiny far-off detail; the lower fifth of the frame stays visually simple (subtitles will sit there). FRAMING FIRST: a tight single-person chest-up close-up — head and shoulders fill the frame, the top of the head near the top edge, the frame cut at mid-chest; the face occupies about one third of the frame height; hands NOT visible; NOT a medium shot, NOT a full-body shot. Full-frame 16:9 image, no black bars. Mouth CLOSED (lips together, no teeth visible); facing the camera, looking into the lens. eye-level, 85mm prime lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on the irises, soft optical bokeh, cinematic portrait. Exactly one person in sharp focus, no foreground shoulder, hands out of frame, chest-up single close-up, facing the camera within 30 degrees. [CHARACTER] Reference image 1 is the APPROVED keyframe face of this character: reproduce exactly this face, hair, eyewear and wardrobe; ignore its background and framing unless the description below says otherwise. Reference image 2 is the location reference: match its architecture, colours, set dressing and light direction; ignore any borders or labels. IDENTITY FIRST: the person is EXACTLY the one in reference image 1 — same face shape, jaw, cheekbones, nose, eyes, eyebrows, skin tone, age, hairstyle and eyewear; only the expression, lighting and framing described below change. Mai, a Japanese woman aged 38, slightly full round face, long loosely waved chestnut-brown hair, arched drawn eyebrows, glossy deep red lipstick, heavy mascara, NO glasses, wearing a brand-new bright soft-pink silk kimono with a scattered cherry-blossom print (flowers only, no writing), a plain cream obi, a thin gold bangle on the left wrist. [ACTION] Chest-up close-up of Mai behind the reception counter facing the guest, three-quarter toward camera, cheeks flushed pink, a faint sheen of sweat at her temples and hairline, brows raised and pulled together, eyes darting, lips parted mid-stammer, one open hand raised to chest height in a flustered explaining gesture, the foreign family a soft blur beyond the counter. [SETTING] Lighting: soft diffused daylight through paper shoji, warm wooden tones, low contrast, gentle shadows.  All papers, screens, signs, scrolls, plates and the noren curtain are completely blank and plain; no letters, numbers, crests or symbols anywhere in the frame; every wall is bare. SETTING: the place is reference image 2 ONLY; the background, furniture, lamps and lighting of reference image 1 must NOT appear. WALL RULE: every wall is completely bare — NO paper notices, NO posters, NO calendars, NO framed writing; NO noren curtain and NO hanging cloth unless the location reference shows one, and then it is plain solid indigo with NO circular crest. Inn entrance hall: the counter top, the guest book and the shoe shelf are plain; the noren is plain solid indigo with NO crest; no notices. FRAMING FIRST: a tight single-person chest-up close-up — head and shoulders fill the frame, the top of the head near the top edge, the frame cut at mid-chest; the face occupies about one third of the frame height; hands NOT visible; NOT a medium shot, NOT a full-body shot. Full-frame 16:9 image, no black bars. Soft fill light keeps the mouth and jaw readable (lip-sync cut). Mouth gently closed or barely parted (speech is added later); natural skin texture, both eyes sharp and symmetrical in focus.
